# 1768. Merge Strings Alternately

## Solution 1 (time O(m+n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def mergeAlternately(self, word1, word2):
        """
        :type word1: str
        :type word2: str
        :rtype: str
        """
        len_1 = len(word1)
        len_2 = len(word2)
        p = 0
        ans = ""
        while p < len_1 and p < len_2:
            ans += word1[p]
            ans += word2[p]
            p += 1
        if p < len_1:
            ans += word1[p:]
        if p < len_2:
            ans += word2[p:]
        return ans
```
